request: show me the matrix that reflects the plane across the x-axis

beats.intent: The grid with i-hat, j-hat and a vector (2, 1.5)

stage.title("Reflect across the x-axis")
p = draw_plane(stage, where="left")
i_hat = draw_vector(stage, p, (1, 0), color=GREEN)
j_hat = draw_vector(stage, p, (0, 1), color=RED)
v = draw_vector(stage, p, (2, 1.5), color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The plane flips over; j-hat now points down
beats.narration: Flip the plane over the x-axis. i-hat stays put, j-hat turns to point straight down, and the yellow vector dips below the axis.
beats.code:
apply_matrix(stage, p, [[1, 0], [0, -1]], riders=[i_hat, j_hat, v])
stage.caption("x stays, y changes sign")

beats.intent: The matrix read off where i-hat and j-hat landed
beats.narration: The columns record where the basis vectors landed: one, zero and zero, minus one.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{bmatrix}", r"\begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \end{bmatrix} \mapsto \begin{bmatrix} x \\ -y \end{bmatrix}", where="right")

beats.intent: Reflecting a second time puts everything back
beats.narration: Reflect again and every vector returns to where it began: doing it twice is doing nothing.
beats.code:
apply_matrix(stage, p, [[1, 0], [0, -1]], riders=[i_hat, j_hat, v])
stage.caption("Twice over: back to the start")

v = draw_vector(stage, p, (1, 1), color=RED)

beats.narration: Apply A: the square is stretched sideways and slanted into a parallelogram.
beats.code:
apply_matrix(stage, p, [[2, 1], [0, 1]], riders=[sq, v])
stage.caption("A stretches and shears")

beats.intent: A inverse times A is the identity
beats.narration: One after the other, A and its inverse change nothing: their product is the identity.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"A^{-1} = \begin{bmatrix} 0.5 & -0.5 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}", r"A^{-1} A = I", where="right")

request: rotate the plane by 45 degrees

beats.narration: i-hat lands at cos 45, sin 45, and j-hat at minus sin 45, cos 45. Those are the columns.

request: why is the derivative of a constant zero

beats.intent: The flat graph of y = 2
beats.narration: A constant function gives the same output everywhere, so its graph is a flat line.
beats.code:
stage.title("Derivative of a constant")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(-1, 5), y_range=(-1, 4))
f = lambda x: 2 + 0 * x
g = plot_graph(stage, ax, f, label="y = 2")

beats.intent: A secant between two points on the line, rise zero
beats.narration: Join any two points on it. The rise is zero, so the slope is zero, however close the points get.
beats.code:
sec = secant_to_tangent(stage, ax, f, 1, h=2)
stage.caption("No rise, so no slope")

beats.intent: The tangent slides along, the slope stuck at 0.00
beats.narration: Slide a tangent along the whole line. The slope readout never moves from zero.
beats.code:
stage.clear(keep=[ax, g])
tan = slide_tangent(stage, ax, f, 0, 4)
stage.caption("Flat everywhere: slope 0")

beats.intent: The limit of c minus c over h
beats.narration: In symbols, the difference quotient is c minus c over h, which is zero before we even take the limit.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"f(x) = c", r"\frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h} = \frac{c - c}{h} = 0", where="right")

request: expected value of a single die roll

beats.intent: Bars of height 1 to 6, one per face

bars = draw_bars(stage, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], labels=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], where="left")

beats.intent: A dashed line at height 3.5 balancing the bars
beats.narration: Each face has a one in six chance. Weight every value by a sixth and add: the balance point is three and a half.
beats.code:
y = bars[0].get_bottom()[1] + 3.5 / 6 * 4.0
level = draw_line(stage, (bars.get_left()[0] - 0.3, y), (bars.get_right()[0] + 0.3, y), color=YELLOW, dashed=True)
stage.equation(r"E = \frac{1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6}{6}", r"= \frac{21}{6} = 3.5", where="right")

beats.intent: The running average of 200 rolls settling at 3.5
beats.narration: Roll two hundred times and keep a running average. It wanders at first, then settles near three and a half.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
rolls = np.random.default_rng(3).integers(1, 7, 200)
avg = np.cumsum(rolls) / np.arange(1, 201)
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 200), y_range=(0, 6), labels=("n", r"\bar{x}"))

down = sq[5].get_center() - sq[0].get_center()

request: prove 1 + 2 + ... + n = n(n+1)/2 with a picture

beats.intent: A second, orange staircase turns over and fits on top

dy = stairs[2].get_center() - stairs[1].get_center()

twin = stairs.copy().set_fill(ORANGE, opacity=0.7)
stage.play(Rotate(twin, PI, about_point=pivot), run_time=2)

beats.code: stage.equation(r"2(1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5) = 5 \cdot 6", r"1 + 2 + \cdots + n = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}", where="right")

stage.clear()

x0 = -5.9

    Line([x0 + roll.get_value(), -1.5 + r, 0],
         [x0 + roll.get_value() - r * np.sin(roll.get_value() / r), -1.5 + r - r * np.cos(roll.get_value() / r), 0], color=YELLOW)))
